turns.text: patient already has abha, how do I log them in with their mobile no

must_contain: Request the OTP with POST /abha/api/v3/profile/login/request/otp using scope abha-login and mobile-verify, loginHint mobile and the encrypted mobile number as loginId.
The login verify call returns a short lived token and a list of accounts, and that token is not the X-token.

Always call /abha/api/v3/profile/login/verify/user with the chosen ABHANumber, the same txnId and the verify token in the T-token header, even when accounts holds one entry, and it returns the X-token.
notes:
The mobile login journey; the skipped account selection step when only one account comes back is the classic mistake. Source lines: catalogue/hiecm/flows/m1-login-by-mobile.md, 'POST /abha/api/v3/profile/login/request/otp
scope [abha-login, mobile-verify], loginHint mobile,

It returns the `X-token` profile calls need.' catalogue/hiecm/endpoints/m1-login-verify.md, 'it returns a short lived `token` and, in `accounts`, every ABHA held against that mobile number.
